europe_now.title: Russian Missile and Drone Attacks Hit Kyiv
europe_now.summary: Russia launched a series of massive missile and drone attacks targeting Kyiv and its surrounding region for the sixth consecutive night. The strikes resulted in casualties among railway workers and hit local infrastructure.

sources.headline: 'Massive' Russian missile, drone attacks on Kyiv
Russian attack hits rail workers in new deadly strikes on Kyiv

europe_now.title: EU Defense and Diplomatic Appointments
europe_now.summary: EU chief diplomat Kaja Kallas has appointed former political and military leaders to a newly formed defense group. Meanwhile, Kallas stated that recent diplomatic efforts regarding the Hormuz region have yielded no results.

sources.headline: EU chief diplomat taps ex-political, military leaders for defense group
Kallas says Hormuz diplomacy has produced ‘no results’

top_stories.title: Russian Strikes on Kyiv
top_stories.summary: Russian forces launched consecutive nightly aerial attacks targeting the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv. The ongoing strikes have caused deadly impacts on railway infrastructure and workers.

top_stories.title: EU Defense Group Formation
top_stories.summary: The European Union's chief diplomat has tapped former political and military leaders for a specialized defense group. This initiative comes as European institutions navigate broader regional security concerns and defense cooperation.
